title: jhum-mapper: Earth Engine and Python code for annual jhum mapping in Mizoram, 1989-2025
description:
Google Earth Engine and Python code for mapping annual shifting-cultivation (jhum) clearing from harmonized Landsat 5/7/8/9 using symmetric anniversary composites of the Normalized Burn Ratio, with a Sentinel-2 implementation for 2025. Includes the compositing experiment, the five-stratum dual-map validation sampler, the sensor consistency and transition tests, the regional transfer test and the scripts that draw every figure in the paper. Mizoram, north-east India, 1989-2025.

Reference data are deposited separately as a dataset under CC BY 4.0.
